study.headline: Obese adults ate the same cut in calories for 8 weeks: 3 meals a day, or 3 meals plus 3 snacks.
study.note: Both groups lost weight. Eating more often didn't add to it.
study.source: Cameron et al., British Journal of Nutrition, 2010
